_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ti xe el Xugador {player_id} in un xugo de LinesOfAction.
Le tue pedine xe '{side}', łe pedine de l'avversario xe '{other}'.
Formato de mòsa: `[b1b3]` (coordinata-de-partensa coordinata-de-destinasion). Na mòsa łegałe traversa orizontalmente, verticalmente o diagonalmente un numaro de caxele uguałe al numaro totałe de pedine (de ogni cołor) in quella łinea. Ti pol saltar sora łe tue pedine, ma no łe pedine de l'avversario; rivar a destinasion so na pedina de l'avversario ła catura.  Vinxi quando tute łe tue pedine xe conese a 8-vixini.

invalid_move.wrong_format: El formato el ga da èsar e2e4 (da,a coordinate).
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: El movimento el ga da esar drito o diagonałe.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Bisogna spostar distansa pari a i tochi in riga.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Un pezzo nemico el bloca la strada.
invalid_move.destination_own: Destinasion ocupà da na propia pedina.

game_action.captured_suffix: Zogador {player_id} ga spostà {from} -> {to} ciapando un nemigo.
